submission.justification: Recommend Algorithm-L1 with a 36.5 GeV threshold. Among the three allowed candidate algorithms, all of which are deployable within the Level-1 FPGA/resource and optical-link budgets, the refined threshold scan found Algorithm-L1 at 36.5 GeV gives the highest recorded signal efficiency: 92.774%. This exceeds the best refined efficiencies for Algorithm-L2 (85.224% at 37.5 GeV) and Algorithm-L3 (74.616% at 34 GeV), while staying within the allowed 20–60 GeV threshold range and the allocated Level-1 trigger-rate context of 8 kHz.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: The overall best refined result is Algorithm-L1 at 36.5 GeV with 92.774% signal efficiency, higher than Algorithm-L2's best 85.224% and Algorithm-L3's best 74.616%; allocated_L1_rate_khz = 8 was the rate target used in the study.
